title: Match the parts
drDigitalIntro:
Every laptop is the same handful of parts, whatever the badge on the lid says.
• The screen shows you what the computer is doing. It is the only part that talks back.
• The keyboard is how you put words in; the trackpad is how you point at things.
• The webcam sits above the screen, and the little light beside it comes on when it is watching.
• The ports along the sides are where everything else plugs in — power, headphones, a memory stick.
• Naming the parts matters for one practical reason: it is how you describe a problem to somebody who can help.

playgroundTask.instructions: Click a dot on the laptop, then click the name it belongs to.

drDigitalSuccess: Wonderful — you know your laptop inside and out!
drDigitalHint: Click a dot on the laptop first, then click the name you think it is. Green means you got it!
